name: Home page | Impossible Foods
mood: blood-red punk poster in velvet darkness
summary: A wine-dark food-brand system with one impossible-red signal, massive condensed display type, compact pill CTAs, flat burgundy product cards, black hairline borders, and irregular masked food photography.
dos: Use giant display type for hero and section statements.
Reserve Impossible Red for actions, active states, and display text.
Pair filled red CTAs with white ghost CTAs.
Use 15px radius for buttons and toggles.
Use organic food masks around hero display type.
Keep the nav bar solid black.
donts: Do not add shadows, glows, or gradients.
Do not introduce additional chromatic colors.
Do not use red for body copy.
Do not use rectangular product photography in hero zones.
Do not use a light page background.
Do not make the display type feel polite or small.
